notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28982688/13c0053f7b29d5351d7e49c838b11ccb78dc34f9.png[/img]
Our first update is out today! 

2 new game modes bring our total challenges up to 13! 

Enjoy our version of the classic snake. Don't run into your tail! The other is not for the queasy; collect packets and stay away from the glitch that follows your every move. 

Also, we fixed a bug that no one reported and now no one ever will!
